review:
Le Vampire moves Smokey into a spooky castle for a cluster game with a progressive Symbol Bar. Filling the bar awards extra free spins and Rainbow symbols, and reaching its fourth level in the bonus unlocks the biggest rewards.

It stands out for its numbers: Hacksaw lists a top RTP version of 97%, among the highest of any Hacksaw slot, alongside 96%, 94%, 92% and 86% versions casinos can choose. Volatility is 3/5 and the max win is 15,000x. Check the info screen to see which RTP a casino runs. It suits Le series fans who want a higher ceiling.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
